title: Primary button text disappears on `/landlord-banking`
acceptance: Both labels and arrows remain readable in default, hover, and keyboard-focus states at 320, 390, and 1440 pixels. Check other consumers of the shared shell.

title: Four article links send readers to a 404 signup page
acceptance: No published article links to the broken destination; the compatibility redirect, if implemented, uses the configured application origin and preserves attribution. Verify navigation without creating an account.

title: The blog introduction delays the content
effort: 3–5 hours. Source: `src/app/blog/page.tsx` and its CSS module.
acceptance: At 390 × 844, aim for first artwork to begin within 560 pixels and its title to be visible by the end of the first screen; retain readable controls, no overlap, and no page overflow at 320 pixels.

title: Blog and article wrapper copy imply a property-only audience
acceptance: Listing heading, supporting copy, page metadata, and shared article CTAs align with the broad homepage positioning; no article body is rewritten as part of the UI change.

title: The blog industry selector offers no useful narrowing
effort: 1–2 hours. Source: industry options derived in `src/app/blog/page.tsx`.
acceptance: Search and category selection still preserve active URL filters; the selector automatically returns when useful choices exist.

title: The mobile navigation toggle has a small hit area
effort: 1–2 hours. Source: `.menuToggle` in `src/components/site-shell.module.css` and responsive header styles.
acceptance: The entire 44-pixel target responds at 320 and 390 pixels, without logo/CTA collisions; Escape, focus return, and scroll lock continue working.

title: Solutions is a long menu, and icon removal is still local
effort: 1–2 hours for validation/release preparation; 1–2 days for group interaction changes.
acceptance: Desktop and mobile have text-only solution entries; long names fit; all 26 destinations remain reachable; keyboard and touch open/close behavior works.

title: Mobile article tools precede the article for nearly a full screen
acceptance: With contents collapsed, the body follows title/audio/taxonomy without an expanded sidebar or full promotional panel in between; contents links still reach headings below the fixed header.

title: The cookie panel obscures the discovery controls
effort: 2–4 hours plus any required copy review.
acceptance: Test first visit, dismissal, and preference reopening at 320, 390, and 1440 pixels; all controls remain visible and keyboard usable. This is a presentation recommendation, not a legal-compliance conclusion.

title: Some CTA labels conceal that they open booking
acceptance: Audit shared primary CTA labels against destinations; booking links and product-detail links are distinguishable before clicking.

title: Skills renders all 319 cards at once
acceptance: Initial result grid contains at most 24 cards; repeated expansion exposes every matching skill without duplicates; filters and empty results work; result changes are announced.

title: Blog topics mix overlapping subjects and formats
effort: 1–2 days for presentation; taxonomy migration is separate.
acceptance: Every existing category remains discoverable and keyboard reachable; combined search/category filters continue working; the active selection is visible even when it lives under More.

title: General pages and footer still default to property management
acceptance: A visitor following Home → Blog → About → Solutions sees consistent umbrella positioning; property vertical pages retain their context; footer links resolve.

title: Two help centers offer different paths and content
effort: 1–2 days for routing/navigation and labeling; substantive help content is a separate project.
acceptance: Header/footer help links converge; old URLs remain usable; search results make their destination type clear; contact options remain available.

title: Product updates reads like evergreen marketing
effort: 1–2 hours for honest relabeling; 1–3 days for a CMS-backed update listing. Source: `src/components/baselane-updates.tsx`.
acceptance: Every item labeled as an update has a real date and change summary; otherwise the navigation/page title accurately says highlights.

title: Solutions repeats its introduction before the directory
acceptance: At 390 pixels, the first industry choice is visible within the initial viewport, with both industry and team/use-case sections still clearly labeled.
